basic_details.scholarship_name: USEFP Fulbright Foreign Student Program for Pakistan
basic_details.offering_entity: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP) & U.S. Department of State (ECA)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Accredited U.S. Universities (Placement arranged centrally via Institute of International Education - IIE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: All academic disciplines are eligible EXCEPT clinical medicine (direct patient contact clinical residency). Public health, health administration, epidemiology, and biomedical sciences are fully eligible.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~130 to 150 awards annually (the largest Fulbright Foreign Student investment worldwide)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: 100% reserved exclusively for Pakistani nationals (~100 Master's, ~30-50 PhD)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 4 to 5 years for PhD

nationality_requirements: Pakistani citizens residing and working in Pakistan throughout the application and selection process
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No official upper age limit, but candidates must be early-to-mid career professionals with demonstrated return commitment to Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of formal education (4-year BS or 2-year BS + 2-year Master's) for Master's applicants; minimum 18 years (MS/MPhil) for PhD applicants from HEC-recognized institutions.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 2.5/4.0 CGPA or 50% marks in annual system; however, competitive admitted applicant average is typically 3.50+ CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Degree relevant to intended field; STEM, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Humanities, Environmental Science, and Business (MBA) welcome.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester (must graduate and receive final degree transcript before U.S. departure in August of following year).
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience is not strictly mandatory for academic fields, but strongly preferred; 2+ years is expected for Public Policy and MBA applicants.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: USEFP does NOT accept IELTS for US university placement. GRE General score is required at application. Once shortlisted, USEFP provides a TOEFL iBT voucher and covers test costs.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all coursework is in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; women, individuals with disabilities, and candidates from Balochistan, Gilgit-Baltistan, AJK, and southern Punjab are strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates with dual U.S.-Pakistani citizenship or permanent residence (Green Card), or whose spouses/parents are U.S. citizens, are INELIGIBLE.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous recipients of long-term U.S. government exchange grants (e.g. Humphrey, previous Fulbright degree) must observe mandatory intervals.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fees and mandatory campus fees paid directly to the host U.S. university.

admission_application_fee.details: IIE manages and pays all university application fees directly.

accommodation.details: Covered via monthly maintenance stipend sufficient for off-campus apartment or campus housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Cost-of-living adjusted monthly stipend determined by U.S. city tiers.

airfare.details: Prepaid round-trip economy class international airfare on Fly America Act compliant carrier from Pakistan to U.S. university city.

visa_fee.details: J-1 Exchange Visitor visa application fee (MRV) and SEVIS fee are fully paid/waived by U.S. Department of State.

health_insurance.details: Accident and Sickness Program for Exchanges (ASPE) health coverage throughout the grant period.

food_allowance.details: Included within the monthly maintenance stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual textbook and professional development allowance (~$1,000/year).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Enrichment seminar travel grants and pre-approved dissertation research allowances available through IIE.

travel_transit_allowance.details: One-time transit and baggage allowance upon arrival (~$500).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple U.S. Universities; IIE submits applications to 4-5 accredited U.S. universities based on student's academic profile and preferences.
participating_institutions: Top U.S. Universities (Columbia, Cornell, NYU, Purdue, UIUC, Texas A&M, Georgia Tech, Michigan State, etc.)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: R1 research universities and top-tier Master's granting U.S. institutions across all 50 states.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / MS degree with transcripts, GRE General score, 3 recommendation letters, Personal Statement, and Study Objective.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Applicants do NOT apply to universities themselves; USEFP and IIE evaluate preferences and match to universities where admission and funding are secure.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus statement on developmental challenges in Pakistan (energy transitions, public health systems, water security, data governance) rather than personal ambition.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create account using primary active email and CNIC on USEFP portal during open cycle (February - April).
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on USEFP online application portal.
2. Complete profile, academic history, and upload scanned degrees/transcripts.
3. Write Study Objective (50 lines) and Personal Statement (50 lines).
4. Submit official GRE General test score code (USEFP institutional code).
5. Register 3 referees who receive automated secure links to submit recommendations directly.
6. Submit online application prior to deadline (mid-April to early May).
7. Preliminary document screening by USEFP committees.
8. In-person panel interviews in Islamabad (July - August).
9. Principal candidate notification in September; candidate takes TOEFL.
10. IIE matches candidate with 4 U.S. universities (October - February).
11. Final U.S. placement confirmed and J-1 visa issued (May - July).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated routing: Apply to USEFP first; selected finalists are placed into universities by IIE.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Online upload by referees through confidential automated email link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal Statement: Personal narrative describing your background, life experiences, and formative influences. Study Objective: Specific academic goals, proposed study plan, and impact on Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a detailed research proposal (3-5 pages) addressing relevance to Pakistani societal/industrial challenges.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV (2 pages max) detailing academic achievements, publications, leadership, and public service.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 20-30 minute panel interview in Islamabad with American diplomats, Pakistani academics, and Fulbright alumni.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General test score is MANDATORY at application. Minimum score threshold is not disclosed, but 300+ is competitive. TOEFL required post-selection.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation is required for degree verification prior to final contract issuance.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation required if any secondary documents are in Urdu.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online portal submission; physical documents requested only upon interview shortlisting.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: 18-month lead time: Apply in Spring 2026 for Fall 2027 matriculation.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Crucial for PhD applicants; publications and thesis quality)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Clarity of vision, resilience, compelling personal narrative)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 5% (Insight from professors and employers on ethics and aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Composure, cross-cultural diplomacy, articulate vision for Pakistan)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Factor in initial screening (GRE quantitative/verbal balance)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Bi-national committees comprising American diplomats, USEFP directors, and prominent Pakistani scholars.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: Blind merit review of online dossier followed by consensus panel interview in Islamabad.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top 10% class ranking, demonstrable leadership outside classroom, publications for PhD candidates.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of top Pakistani universities (LUMS, NUST, IBA, Quaid-i-Azam, UET, AKU) alongside strong representation from public provincial universities.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam portals mimicking USEFP asking for PKR 15,000 to 50,000 'processing fees'. Official USEFP portal is completely FREE.
Fake Facebook groups claiming 'Guaranteed Fulbright Selection' through internal connections.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: USEFP NEVER charges an application fee or processing fee at any stage.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: USEFP strictly prohibits agents. Applications written by consultants are routinely detected and permanently blacklisted.
hidden_costs_breakdown: GRE General test registration fee ($220 / ~PKR 62,000) paid out-of-pocket prior to application.
HEC degree attestation fees (approx PKR 5,000 to 12,000).
Travel to Islamabad for in-person interview (USEFP does not reimburse domestic interview travel).
Medical checkup costs at panel clinics prior to visa.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You must have a 4.0 CGPA to win. (Fact: Holistic review balances leadership and vision; many 3.2-3.4 CGPA winners succeed with exceptional impact).
MYTH: You can remain in the US and transition directly to H-1B or Green Card. (Fact: Legally barred by Section 212(e) 2-year home residency rule).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party blogs often claim IELTS is accepted; official USEFP guidelines mandate GRE and exclusively sponsor TOEFL iBT.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum 3.0 / 4.0 (Grade B average) across all semesters at the U.S. institution.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time student enrollment mandatory; dropping below minimum credits results in grant revocation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual academic progress reports submitted by university academic advisor to IIE.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: On-campus work permitted up to 20 hours/week ONLY with prior written approval from IIE Fulbright advisor. Off-campus employment strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY 2-Year Home Residency Requirement (Section 212(e)). Grantees must physically reside in Pakistan for at least 2 full cumulative years before becoming eligible for U.S. H, L, or permanent resident visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Legal bond signed with USEFP agreeing to return and serve in Pakistan.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Grantees who drop out, fail to maintain academic standing, violate U.S. laws, or fail to return to Pakistan must repay the full dollar value of the grant (typically $150,000+).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly disallowed unless extreme institutional closure or departmental emergency occurs, subject to IIE approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Strictly prohibited; must complete degree in the approved academic field specified in the grant agreement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond normal degree duration are rarely granted and require rigorous academic justification without additional stipend funding.
